hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote via a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to settle balances directly—bypassing standard concentrated liquidity. beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate always revert to prevent non-productive positions.
